plainText:
Wataru Takagi (Japanese: 高木渉 Takagi Wataru) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Takagi was born on July 25, 1966 in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and voiced a number of characters for many Japanese anime series. Takagi joined the during the , voicing Fergus in the first movie before moving on to other roles. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency and was once a member of the Katsuta Voice Actor's Academy.
